name: Izumi Yukari
source:
A 2nd year student at St. Claus Academy. Yukari is Yumi's classmate, and likes to take care of others. She is the treasurer of the student council. Since Yukari follows fads closely, she is quite well-informed. She became best friends with Yumi after the later's transferral into the academy, and is supportive of her.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.zutto-otome.jp/memories/memories_chara/cha_girls.html]official website profile[/URL].]
